checksum-warning: The patch's own checksum did not match this ROM. The new ROM may not work.
compat-no-browser-core: None of the emulators RomM's browser player has for this console is known to run this hack. Download the installed ROM and play it in one of the emulators listed above.
drop-patch-hint: The patch file or the zip / 7z / rar it came in.
ftp-admin-only: Only admins can change where Send with FTP sends games.
ftp-after-install: Send with FTP to {target} after installing
ftp-desc: Send installed hacks (or any game) from RomM to another device's FTP server, such as a jailbroken PS5 running an FTP payload next to RetroArch. Games go to the base path, then the console's folder, then the Hacks folder if you want one.
ftp-enabled-desc: Adds a Send with FTP button next to installed hacks for everyone who can install hacks.
ftp-existing: If the file is already there
ftp-folder-found: This folder is on the device
ftp-folder-new: Not on the device yet; it is created on the first send
ftp-folders-desc: Each platform's games go to a folder named like its RomM folder unless you type another name. The path under each platform shows where an installed hack lands.
ftp-hacks-always: Always put games in the Hacks folder
ftp-hacks-match: Same as in RomM (when saved to a Hacks folder)
ftp-hacks-never: Never; next to the other games
ftp-leave-body: Your FTP settings aren't saved yet.
ftp-passive-desc: Most console FTP servers need this. Turn it off only if transfers hang at the start.
ftp-save-check-failed: Couldn't check whether the file is already on the device: {error}
ftp-save-exists: {name} is already in this folder. Sending replaces it; the old file is kept next to it as a .bak copy.
ftp-save-file-name-hint: RetroArch finds a save by the game's file name, so keep it the same as the game's.
ftp-save-no-folder-save: No saves folder is set in Settings > Send with FTP yet.
ftp-save-no-folder-state: No save states folder is set in Settings > Send with FTP yet.
ftp-save-use-settings: Send to the folder from settings
ftp-saves-desc: Where Send with FTP puts a game's saves and save states (the Send with FTP button on a game's Save data tab). Use RetroArch's saves and states folders on the device. Each file is named after the game, the way RetroArch looks for it, and a file already there is kept as a .bak copy before it's replaced.
ftp-saves-example: A Super Nintendo game played with Snes9x would go to
ftp-saves-layout-content: One per console folder (sort by content directory)
ftp-saves-layout-core: One per core (sort by core name)
ftp-saves-not-set: (not set; you pick a folder each time)
ftp-states-path: Save states folder on the device
ftp-test-no-platforms: None of your consoles' folders are in {path}, so games would go into new folders there. Check the base path: RetroArch usually keeps games in its content folder, such as /data/homebrew/PPSA99169/content on a PS5.
ftp-tls-desc: Only for servers that support it; console FTP payloads usually don't.
hacks-folder: Save to a Hacks folder in this platform's folder
index-error: Could not reach the RomStop index: {error}
install-only: This is a {kind}, not a single-file patch, so RomM can't install it onto a ROM. Install it on your console or emulator:
install-waiting-scan: Patched. It shows up in the library after the next scan.
lede: Romhacks from RomStop for the games in your library. A green check means you have the exact ROM a hack needs; a caution sign means you have the game, but not the version it needs.
mario-scale-sm64: SMW Central's Super Mario 64 scale; descriptions by RomStop.
mario-scale-smw: Difficulty scale and descriptions from SMW Central.
mod-install-vita: Install builds a new .vpk from your game with this rePatch mod's files swapped in, and adds it to your library. Install it in Vita3K like any game. Your original dump isn't changed.
mod-install-wii: Install adds a new entry next to your disc: a Dolphin launcher (.json) that boots your own disc with this Riivolution mod, plus the mod's files. Your disc isn't changed. Keep the two in the same folder: ES-DE and Dolphin list it as one game.
need-likely: This looks like the right ROM
no-checksum: RomStop has no checksum for this hack's ROM yet.
no-permission: You need upload rights to install hacks.
no-results-hint: Try another console, type or search.
no-rom-for-hack: None of your ROMs is {rom}. Add it to RomM and it shows up here.
no-saved-hint: Use the bookmark on a hack to save it, say for a game you still need to add. Saved hacks are kept in RomM for your account.
none-hint: RomStop has {n} hacks, none of them for this game yet.
older-version-hint: RomStop has no download for this version. Download it from the hack's page and drop it here.
open-base-rom: Open the original game in your library
reason-checksum-differs: You're on {yours}, and its checksum differs from {rom}.
reason-checksum-header: Its checksum matches once the header is set aside. Install handles the header for you.
reason-file-name: Matched by file name. RomStop has no checksum to confirm it.
reason-missing-header: You're on {yours}. It's the right game data, but it has no header and this patch needs one. Use a copy of {rom} with its header.
reason-revision: You're on {yours}, a different revision. This hack needs {rom}.
reason-title: Same game and region. RomStop has no checksum to confirm it.
roll-none: No eligible rom hacks to randomize
save-failed: Couldn't update your saved hacks. Try again.
saves-changed: RomM changed while you were reviewing. Scan again.
saves-conflicts: {n} files have the same name as a different save in RomM. Choose Keep both or Skip for each; they are left out until you do.
saves-detect-hint: Reads RetroArch's core folders and playlists and ES-DE's emulator choices. Save states only load in the emulator that made them.
saves-folders-hint: Add every folder that holds saves: RetroArch's saves and states folders (or the whole RetroArch folder), ROM folders when saves sit next to the games, and standalone emulators' folders. Adding ES-DE's folder lets it read which emulator each system uses. Only save files are uploaded; ROMs are only read to find renamed games.
saves-lede: Pick your RetroArch, ES-DE or emulator folders. Saves, save states and state screenshots are matched to your games and uploaded as {user}. Nothing already in RomM is replaced, and nothing on this device is changed.
saves-rename-ask: {n} files are named differently from their game in RomM. RomM's player and RetroArch Cloud Sync find saves by the game's file name. Rename them to match? (Only RomM's copy is renamed.)
this-is-hack: This is {title} {version}, a hack of {game} installed from RomStop.
title: RomStop
unsupported-hint: RomStop doesn't index hacks for this platform.
unsupported-title: No RomStop hacks for this platform
